evidence.observation: H701 reads 438.9 °C while H702 is 73.7 °C and the reboiler vessel is 70.5 °C, a large unexplained discrepancy.
H701 has risen to 443.3 °C, while H702 is 69.3 °C and the vessel is 71.7 °C; actual heater overheating versus a measurement fault remains unresolved.
System pressure is 500.25 mbar, column differential pressure 0.6 mbar, buffer differential pressure 2.75 mbar, and cooling-water flow 6.8; these do not establish a pressure or cooling failure.
Distillate and reflux flows are 0.2 and 0.05, following repeated near-zero readings; no composition measurement has been provided.

args.missing_evidence: Independent H701 temperature measurement, heater power and controller setpoint/status, permitted heater-temperature limits, and sensor/raw acquisition checks are needed to distinguish real overheating from a measurement or software fault; composition analysis and target specification are needed to judge separation.
